title: eat shit & die 149
author: bpatrick
html: Another comic from ’08. I always get nervous leaving books on car seats. I have an urge to hide them under the seat or in the glove-box but then I remember that no one reads anyway. I’d have mixed feelings if someone busted out my window just to get to a book.
